title: Radiators and Glasshouse
author: Emrys Vasquez
blurb: Paloma Sandoval, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the demolition date arrives.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
